title: Bravo award for running five innovation events in two years
summary: IBM recognized my passion for innovation and tech vitality after I organized five hackdays and events in my first two years.
what_would_have_happened: The lab's innovation events would have relied on fewer volunteers to run them.
the_call: Keep organizing events for the lab alongside product delivery.
what_i_did: Organized Hackday 6, Hackday 7, the Worldwide Bluehouse Hackday, Lotus Knows and Manyata Fun Day.
what_changed: IBM Bravo award, October 2009, naming all five events.
